acceptanceScope: User-approved fixed-fixture application capability and lifecycle profile; not kernel isolation or arbitrary generated code activation.
limitations: node:vm is not a security mechanism for arbitrary hostile code; only reviewed fixed snippets are admitted.
Worker resourceLimits bound V8 heap/stack, not process RSS or arbitrary external allocations. Typed-array/ArrayBuffer/DataView globals are removed in the fixed VM profile.
No kernel network/filesystem denial or packet-capture certification is claimed. The stronger optional native profile remains unavailable when bootstrap controls fail.
The application parser bounds result bytes/depth/nodes; it does not claim an independent 64MiB native validator acceptance.
